interpretation: Retrieval is the binding constraint. F_0.5 = 1.25R/(0.25+R), so at perfect precision this recall supports at most F_0.5 = 0.9456; reaching 0.95 needs pair recall >= 0.7917. The plan is 1.51 points of recall short of that. address_token is the single largest contributor (+0.1519 marginal) and numeric_token is nearly dead (+0.0005), so the token strategies, not the exact-match ones, are where the headroom is. The cap sweep is nearly flat: 200 costs 1.96 points of pair recall, 400 costs 0.96, and the median is 41 candidates at every cap, so a cap trades a little recall for a large cut in pair count with no effect on the typical query.
